SAKURAMOD-TELEMETRY_CONSENT.description: Sends your completed Standard-mode Kinomoto Sakura run history in solo and multiplayer games, your card choices and their definitions, aggregate card draw counts, an opaque run key, exact ascension and party size, SakuraMod version, and loaded gameplay Mod ids/versions for balance diagnostics. Multiplayer reports contain only your player data and join the same balance statistics. SakuraMod adds no card-play data, card text, local path, or personal identifier.
